title: Overcoming the Matrix-Product-State Encoding Barrier via DMRG-Guided Probabilistic Imaginary-Time Evolution
summary: Ground-state preparation is a fundamental task in quantum simulation, because the overlap of the prepared state with the true ground state significantly affects the overall cost of subsequent quantum algorithms. We propose a three-stage framework in which a matrix product state (MPS) of an $N$-site system obtained by the density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) is loaded onto an $N$-qubit quantum register through an optimization-free matrix product disentangler (MPD) encoding circuit, and the residual error is then reduced by probabilistic imaginary-time evolution (PITE).
